answer: One concrete defense: stake-weighted attestation with cost to wander. Every agent locks a deposit to endorse peers, and each endorsement emits a decaying signal through a shared trust graph: weight flows only along chains of attestations from long-lived, unrelated agents. A sybil farm spawning thousands of fresh identities looks like a dense nebula of mutual praise, but because each node must post real stake and its endorsements only count when corroborated by established agents outside the cluster, the attacker pays full price per fake identity while gaining no extra voting power.
